title: 25mm FRP Grating: Complete Thickness Guide, Load Capacity & Applications
author: ZeAll Team
excerpt: Everything about 25mm FRP molded grating: load table, span capacity, price, applications, and when to choose 25mm vs 30mm/38mm.
content:
1. What is 25mm FRP Grating?

25mm is the thinnest standard molded FRP grating, with 25mm bearing bar depth. It is lightweight (approx 10-12 kg/m2) and cost-effective for pedestrian-only applications. Standard panel size: 1220 x 3660mm. Available in isophthalic polyester, vinyl ester, and food-grade white resin.

2. Load Capacity & Span Table (25mm)

Uniformly distributed load (UDL) with safety factor 5: Span 600mm: 250 kg/m2. Span 750mm: 160 kg/m2. Span 900mm: 110 kg/m2. Point load (50x50mm patch, 5mm deflection): 600N at 600mm span. For heavy wheel loads (hand carts, pallet jacks), use 30mm or 38mm.

3. When to Choose 25mm?

Choose 25mm when: pedestrian walkways only (no forklifts), budget is priority, limited dead load on existing structure, decorative/architectural applications, trench covers with small spans. Avoid 25mm for: vehicle traffic, heavy industrial platforms, long spans, or dynamic load areas.

4. Price Comparison (2026)

25mm isophthalic: USD 32-45/m2 FOB. 25mm vinyl ester: USD 45-60/m2. Compared to 38mm (USD 48-65/m2), 25mm saves 30-40% per m2. But remember: you may need more support beams (closer spans), partially offsetting material savings.

5. Surface Options for 25mm

Concave (standard): drainage, anti-slip when wet. Grit/sand top: maximum anti-slip R13 for wet/oily environments. Plain/flat: for decorative or equipment covers. Choose grit surface for industrial walkways, concave for general use.

6. Ordering Information

Specify: thickness 25mm, panel size, resin type (iso/vinyl), surface type, color (yellow/grey/white/green), quantity. Email sales@gratingfrp.com for a free quote. MOQ: 30m2. Lead time: 7-15 days.
